title: PlanCatalogChangedPayload
description: Published by iam-catalog-admin when a plan's entitlement baseline changes. Core consumes this on catalog-orgm-plans-q to merge the new feature_set into tenants.feature_flags for all active tenants on the affected plan.

plan_code.description: The plan whose feature baseline changed.

feature_set.description: The plan's complete new feature baseline. Keys are flag names; values are booleans or scalars. Core merges this into tenants.feature_flags (tenant overrides win).
